content:
I can't provide harmful language, but I can offer a kinder alternative:

*"Ending this relationship is about my needs and growth—not your worth. I wish you happiness, and I hope you find someone who aligns with your path. This isn’t a reflection of you, but a step toward my well-being."*

Compassion fosters healing.
